## Breaking change
Hyperion default_color parameter will no longer set the Hyperion default color (and that configuration option is now deprecated). Instead, users should use light profiles (as per https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/light/)

<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

The current Hyperion integration does not work with the. current version of Hyperion (see this bug: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/36471 ). This PR rewrites the integration to actually work -- uses the current API, and takes advantage of features such as subscriptions in order to avoid polling.

First of all, thank you that you rewrite this integration :)
I tested it as an custom integration, everything seems to run fine. I just noticed one small problem with it.

I shutdown my hyperion every day. Currently the integration seems to be unable to reconnect if I turn on my hyperion again.

Is it possible that you can implement an reconnect into this integration?

@N1c093 It should already do this. Let me test -- when you say "shutdown my hyperion every day", do you mean:
 - You disable the LED output via the web UI, but leave the process and device running.
 - Or: You shut down the process, but leave the device running.
 - Or: You power down the device entirely.
My refactor is complete. Due to the volume of difference from this original PR, I've created a new one (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/39738) and will now close this one out.

issue_context.body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST:
  - If you need additional help with this template, please refer to https://www.home-assistant.io/help/reporting_issues/
  - Make sure you are running the latest version of Home Assistant before reporting an issue: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/releases
  - Do not report issues for integrations if you are using custom components or integrations.
  - Provide as many details as possible. Paste logs, configuration samples and code into the backticks.
  DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! Otherwise, your issue may be closed without comment.
-->
## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened.
-->
The Hyperion integration is currently not working correctly, it has effects that are currently not supported by Hyperion and is also missing some of the newer ones added. 

Also the switch on and off does not work correctly, it will toggle on and off with out making any changes to the light itself. You can call light.turn_off and light.turn_on in automations as well as effects in automation's but the switch and effects in the light card do not work correctly. 

I think the integration is using the now depreciated Hyperion API located here: https://github.com/hyperion-project/hyperion 
and should be updated to match the new version Hyperion.ng located here: https://github.com/hyperion-project/hyperion.ng

you can find the new API documented here: 
https://docs.hyperion-project.org/en/json/

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.110.4
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 
Not sure I have only used the newer hyperion.ng

- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Docker
- Integration causing this issue: Hyperion
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/hyperion/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml
  - platform: hyperion
    host: 192.168.1.21
    name: Hyperion
    hdmi_priority: 240
    default_color: 
      - 000
      - 000
      - 000

```

## Traceback/Error logs
<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt
none
```

## Additional information

Hyperion integration needs to be updated to use newer API it currently doesnt work and is built for a depreciated version.
comments: Something weird I noticed if I double tap the toggle for the light it works as expected for both on and off, not sure what to make of that though.

Here is a clip of the issue with the toggle

https://photos.app.goo.gl/AtwT8CruBw6JyxuR7
Confirmed the same issue with Hyperion 2.0.0-alpha.7.
I have started working on updating this component to the current API: https://github.com/dermotduffy/hass-core/commit/180ad1c6e94c54a9c0fd83e638f1acdc50ec1c37
Just tested as a custom component and everything is working as expected from my brief testing.

Thanks for testing, much appreciated! I'm still working on this, turned into more of an overhaul:
- Convert to an async component.
- Convert to 'Local Push' instead of polling to take advantage of the subscription API.
- Support API authentication.

I'll hopefully have something PR-worthy within the next week. If you're willing, would love a re-test with the finished product.

The fix for this has actually broken my ability to turn my lights off via home assistant.

I never actually had any issues before other than the effects list not updating (wasn't to bothered about that) so not sure why it is now broken.

I'm running the latest alpha of hyperion ng hyperion (v8) and the integration just seems to cancel running effects but not set the leds to black

@Joeboyc2 When the effect/color is canceled, nothing should be displayed (i.e. this should be equivalent to setting the LEDs to black, which just turns them off).

Would you mind filing a new bug against me, ideally with a set of steps for me to try to reproduce what you are seeing, and a description of what behavior you expect?

We no longer allow changes to YAML configuration for integration that communicate with a device or service.

For more information see:

- ADR-0007: <https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/blob/master/adr/0007-integration-config-yaml-structure.md#decision>
- ADR-0010: <https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/blob/master/adr/0010-integration-configuration.md>

This integration needs to be adjusted to use a configuration flow. To get started on that, see our developer documentation:

<https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/config_entries_config_flow_handler>

Thank you -- I will work on that. I'm also refactoring the network connection out of the integration and into a common library. These changes will take some time though, so the integration will thus need to remain non-functional (unless someone beats me to it).
